decisions.reason: Requiring the concurrence letter to be signed and PE-stamped does not change the photos, room identifiers, location markups, or other documentation needed to verify the completed changes.
The letter signature and stamp request changes the presentation of the concurrence package, not the scope or intended outcome of the electrical as-built review.
The client requests a signature and missing PE stamp but does not change the selected Nevada PE's name, license number, or attribution.
This candidate concerns a separate additional permit project; the request to sign and stamp the as-built concurrence letter does not alter its drawing or stamping requirements.
The source request concerns the concurrence letter and does not resolve or modify the separate California electrical PE credential requirement.
Signing and stamping the concurrence letter does not change the calculation obligations for the separate additional permit project.
The concurrence-letter presentation change has no effect on the separate Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D calculation requirements.
